text_en: Jinshi Data, October 31 — The 2026 World Cities Day global main event and the fourth Global Award for Sustainable Development in Cities (Shanghai Award) ceremony were held on the 31st in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the opening ceremony, presented awards to the winning cities and delivered a speech. He Lifeng noted that in the new era, the Chinese government, following President Xi Jinping's important instructions, has fully practiced the people-centered city concept and achieved historic progress in urban development. Basically all people have access to housing, high-quality and full employment has been achieved for the urban population, harmony has been fostered between people and between people and nature, historical and cultural heritage has been effectively protected, and urban governance capacity has been continuously enhanced. At present and for a period to come, we will follow the arrangements of the Central Urban Work Conference, aim to build innovative, livable, beautiful, resilient, civilized and smart modern people-centered cities, and forge a path with Chinese characteristics.
